results.question: Who are the best landscapers in Elizabethtown, KY?

chatgpt.text:
For a homeowner in Elizabethtown, I’d start with these:

- **Duvall’s Landscaping** — best for curb-appeal projects: bed renovation, planting, mulch/edging, and softscape design. They’re Hardin County–based and emphasize residential/commercial landscaping with free estimates. ([duvallslandscaping.com](https://www.duvallslandscaping.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Fentress Landscape & Lawn Care** — strong pick for a local lawn-and-landscape combo; listed as locally owned, licensed and insured, with very strong review listings. ([fentresslandscaping.com](https://fentresslandscaping.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Dixie Yard Works** — good if you want a one-stop shop for design/build, plants, stone, hardscapes, mulch, and materials; they’re on N. Dixie Hwy in Elizabethtown. ([dixieyardworks.com](https://dixieyardworks.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Evergreen Landscaping & Garden Center** — worth calling for landscape installation plus plant/nursery help; Birdeye shows a 4.8 rating with 35 reviews. ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/evergreen-landscaping-garden-center-156202692004225?utm_source=openai))  
- **Bluegrass Garden Center and Landscaping** — good for low-maintenance landscape design/install; Kentucky Proud lists them at 626 Westport Road. ([kyagr.com](https://www.kyagr.com/AgBusiness/10291?utm_source=openai))  

I’d get 2–3 quotes and ask for proof of insurance, recent local photos, and a plant warranty.

gemini.text:
If you’re looking to upgrade your yard in E-town, a few local companies consistently come recommended by homeowners:

*   **Greenwell’s Landscaping:** A local favorite, especially for custom design and hardscaping like patios and retaining walls. They are known for meticulous attention to detail and reliable communication.
*   **The Grounds Guys of Elizabethtown:** Great if you want a polished, professional crew that handles everything from routine lawn maintenance to seasonal cleanups and irrigation. They’re super dependable and easy to work with.
*   **Bluegrass Lawn & Landscaping:** Excellent for larger residential projects, grading, and sod installation. Neighbors frequently praise their efficiency and fair pricing.

**My advice?** Call Greenwell’s if you’re doing a major custom outdoor living project. Reach out to The Grounds Guys if you need reliable ongoing maintenance and general upkeep. Always get at least two quotes to compare timelines and vibes before signing!
